evidence: interface with execute(String[]) + tab-complete(String[]) implemented by every /route subcommand; registry MixinHelper5 maps keys to it

ClientCommand "/route": builds the arg tree, dispatches to subcommands via Map<String,RouteSubcommand> (help/save/start/clone/cancel/reset/info/show/delete/select/deselect/section/list/meta/sectionmeta/whitelist/blacklist); gated to dungeons
ClientCommand "warp": sends "/warp <destination>", autocompletes from the server warp list, only on SkyBlock island
ClientCommand "sendcoords": broadcasts "x/y/z" to all/party/guild/officer/coop chat channels
/route reset: resets progress for the current room (RouteTracker.method15)
/route cancel: cancels the active route recording ("recordingCancelled")
/route sectionmeta: edits per-section meta swaponlocked + text holograms add/remove ("metaForCurrentSection")
/route blacklist: list/add/remove/clear rooms ("roomBlackList")
/route clone: clones the selected route under a new name ("successfullyClonedRoute")
/route list: lists routes in the current room with [B]uiltin/[H]idden tags and click-to-select ("routesInCurrentRoom")
/route deselect: clears the active route section ("routeDeselected")
/route select <name>: resolves name or routeName:section link and selects it ("selectedRoute")
/route whitelist: list/add/remove/clear rooms ("roomWhitelist")
/route meta: edits route meta hidden + swaponcomplete ("metaForCurrent")
/route delete <name>: warns about swapOnComplete/swapOnLocked dependents then deletes ("routeDeleteSuccess")
/route show [name]: toggles showing all routes in the room or finds one ("showingAllRoutesInCurrentRoom")
/route start: starts/resets route recording ("freeToStartRecording")
/route save <name>: saves the current recording to a route ("successfullySaved")
/route help: prints help for meta/sectionmeta/whitelist/blacklist
/route section prev|next|<index>: switches the active route section ("currentRouteSection")
/route info <name>: looks up a route by name/owner-name and prints it ("foundRoute")
event handler managing GUI modules: registers ScreenModule/OverlayModule lists, tracks the active screen (field12) and open overlays (field11), opens/closes on EventScreenUpdate
per-GUI widget state cache: Map<guiId, Map<widgetId, WidgetState>>, hover/scale animation, marks states dirty; beginWidget/endWidget/isDirty
filled-rectangle renderer: method1(x,y,w,h,color) batches draws and flushes (method17) with a dirty IntRectangle for old MC scissor
clip-rectangle stack: push/intersect (method1/2), applies glScissor via Bridge7Iterator.method113, contains/outside tests (method4/5)
per-GUI key-event queue: method2 queues KeyEventBridge, method18 returns last frame's keys, shift-down check
per-rect scroll offset animation: accumulates a float (ThreadModuleDump47.Data) and applies a z-translation around a render runnable
inventory slot-grid renderer: draws 9-wide item slots, quick-craft drag selection, shift-click, slot-lock and protect-item overlays
titled window/panel renderer: method1/2 draw panel borders/background from GuiTheme and centre a title
item-stack renderer: draws the stack, durability bar, stack-size overlay, rarity background and search-highlight, fires EventRenderItemStackSize
box/border renderer: panel box (method1), inset box (method2/3) and separator line (method4) using GuiTheme colours
scaled text renderer: method1/2 draw text at a scale (with optional scissor), getStringWidth, method3 computes fit scale
text-input renderer/editor: placeholder, cursor blink, selection highlight, key handling, returns the edited text
mouse input handler: press/release tracking and a deferred click queue (List<MouseClick>) polled per rect for widget activation
abstract base of every GUI subsystem: holds the GuiRenderer, exposes sibling accessors and theme, start()/end() lifecycle
pushed/popped GUI render state: visibility flags, clip rectangle, search text and x/y/z scale; copied on push (MixinHelper.method3/4)
completed mouse click record (x, y, button): contains(rect) test and button getter, queued by MouseInput
per-widget persistent state (id, x, y, w, h, scale, isDirty) with hover/update/delete hooks, owned by WidgetStateCache
dispatches render/scroll/click/drag/key events to the active screen module or, failing that, to all open overlay modules; queues tasks until a module is active
concrete GUI module shown as an overlay on top of the current screen (registered/activated via GuiModuleManager field10/field11)
abstract GUI module base: render(screen,matrix,x,y,partialTicks), scroll/click/drag/key hooks and onClose; superclass of ScreenModule/OverlayModule
